name: Look-ahead in the live ledger
test: any live pick frozen at or after kickoff
why: a pick that could not have been placed is not evidence

name: Settlement integrity failure
test: a settled live pick lacks an official outcome or pnl
statistic: field check on every settled pick (demotion_gate.evaluate)
why: no strategy stays funded on unverifiable evidence

name: Sample floor
test: DG4 and DG5 apply only above 100 settled bets over 3 seasons
why: below the floor the verdict is INSUFFICIENT, never PASS and never DEMOTE

name: Stressed economics
statistic: mean of pnl_stress over the window
why: the strategy must survive a worse price than it got

name: Significance
test: lower 95% bound of the weekly ROI bootstrap <= 0
why: a positive point estimate is not enough to stay funded

name: Closing-line value
test: mean CLV < 0 when CLV is present on every window bet
statistic: mean of clv over the window
why: a strategy paying worse than the close is losing the only edge that repeats

name: Live ROI interval below zero  ·  PROPOSED
test: upper bound of the weekly-block 95% interval on live ROI < 0
statistic: weekly-block bootstrap of mean pnl; not in demotion_gate.py
why: a stricter mirror of DG5 that demotes a confirmed loser rather than an unproven winner

name: Signal decay  ·  PROPOSED
test: the live signal to pnl rank correlation is negative with an interval excluding zero while the backtest's was positive
statistic: Spearman rho, weekly-block interval; not in demotion_gate.py
why: the model's own disagreement stopped predicting the outcome, which no ROI test detects
